description: West African naming pool deduplication using Jaro-Winkler full name similarity only. Trained on 3,598 labelled candidate pairs from 12 agricultural programmes in Nigeria (FutuX Agri-consult Limited, 2021-2026). Training data is private; only these weights are published.
training_context: West African naming pools (northern Nigeria). Patronymic naming structures. Shannon entropy H=10.355 bits for given names. Calibrated for populations where same-name collision rate is elevated.
